name: Stefan Bobrowski
title: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Engineer with 11+ years of professional experience building fast, polished web applications that drive measurable business growth across e-commerce, media platforms, and enterprise products. My core stack is JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Vite, SCSS, and API development with Node.js and Express. Throughout my career I’ve had a solid eye for UI/UX, performance, and accessibility. Currently expanding into cloud architecture on Google Cloud Platform and pursuing Associate Cloud Engineer certification.

experience.summary: Architected and developed Vite + React + TypeScript frontend application in close collaboration with UI/UX lead. Established CI/CD pipelines and managed repository infrastructure with GitHub Actions and Docker. Contributed to full-stack architectural decisions including cloud platform selection and API design.

Implemented CRO-focused UI/UX redesigns across critical e-commerce flows (checkout, cart, login, returns) in a Next.js production environment serving thousands of users daily. Integrated feature flags and A/B tests via Contentful. Reduced frontend bundle size from ~50MB to ~12MB (~70% build time reduction). Consolidated GraphQL requests reducing API overhead and improving performance.

Led development of 'Questions & Answers' component redesign using Figma, React, and GraphQL, improving engagement and CTR. Served as Release Captain managing PRs, release notes, and production deployments. Increased test coverage to 100% for multiple components by transitioning from Enzyme to RTL + Jest. Mentored new engineers on best practices.

Architected and led development of Nomad Portal, a digital asset management platform with React, Redux-Saga, Node.js/Express, and AWS AI services for facial recognition and metadata tagging. Built VEP Virtual Stage, a live-streaming platform featuring multi-stream viewing, WebSockets-based live chat, and configurable JSON-based theming.

Developed full-stack applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). Converted React Class Components to Hooks with useContext state management. Built REST APIs with Express and Mongoose.

Developed product microsites and checkout component for payment API integration. Improved SEO and accessibility with metadata and Structured Data markup. Researched emerging technologies including Web Components and Vue.js for future architecture.
